title: Question 30
passage:
How many ceramic bowls are ready for pickup?
A. Two. The third one is still in the kiln. B. We close at six this evening. C. The ceramic bowls are in cardboard boxes.
passageZh:
有幾個陶瓷碗可以領取了？

B. 我們今天傍晚六點關門。
C. 陶瓷碗裝在紙箱裡。
